description_en: Deletes all client IDs of a device in the unique-certificate-per-product authentication scenario without pre-registration, if the number of device identifiers exceeds the limit of 5
description_zh: 一型一密免注册场景下，若单个设备的标识个数超出限制（5个），可调用该接口删除设备下的所有标识
kebab_example: aliyun iot delete-client-ids --iot-id BXPV9Ks3bxwM9fD00000000101 --iot-instance-id iot-12000078 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteClientIds

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>ID value is displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
